propositions: close_ticket releases the status lock before the signing tail runs, allowing a SigningError to occur ~60s after the close lands durably
the SigningError exception is caught and logged to stderr with exit 0, but the payload carries no field reporting the signature failure, making the loss undetectable programmatically
callers cannot distinguish between successful closes and closes-without-signature, forcing re-runs of already-closed transitions
the completion_signature marker must be threaded through all three public surfaces: rebar.transition(), CLI --output json, and MCP transition_ticket
the message must state the close landed and only the signature failed, not present the lock error as a close failure
idea → closed transitions should omit the completion_signature key since a reject/drop of an undesigned idea is not a completion event
